turns.text: That sounds perfect for zoning in on design details. Speaking of design and focus, have you had any time to get out with your camera lately, or has work kept you too occupied for photography?

turns.text: I actually brought my camera along on my long walk this morning! The autumn light hitting the brick buildings in Chicago right now is gorgeous, so I managed to capture a few neat street shots before the studio opened.
